heading: Time instant
text: A temporal entity with zero extent or duration

heading: Temporal entity
text: A temporal interval or instant.

heading: Proper interval
text: A temporal entity with non-zero extent or duration, i.e. for which the value of the beginning and end are different

heading: Time interval
text: A temporal entity with an extent or duration

heading: Generalized duration description
text: Description of temporal extent structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system.

heading: Temporal position
text: A position on a time-line

heading: Date-Time description
text: Description of date and time structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system. The temporal reference system is fixed to Gregorian Calendar, and the range of year, month, day properties restricted to corresponding XML Schema types xsd:gYear, xsd:gMonth and xsd:gDay, respectively.

heading: Time duration
text: Duration of a temporal extent expressed as a number scaled by a temporal unit

heading: Month of year
text: The month of the year

heading: Generalized date-time description
text: Description of date and time structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system

heading: Anno
text: Year duration

heading: Date-time interval
text: DateTimeInterval is a subclass of ProperInterval, defined using the multi-element DateTimeDescription.

heading: Temporal Reference System
text:
A temporal reference system, such as a temporal coordinate system (with an origin, direction, and scale), a calendar-clock combination, or a (possibly hierarchical) ordinal system. 

This is a stub class, representing the set of all temporal reference systems.

heading: Time Zone
text:
A Time Zone specifies the amount by which the local time is offset from UTC. 
	A time zone is usually denoted geographically (e.g. Australian Eastern Daylight Time), with a constant value in a given region. 
The region where it applies and the offset from UTC are specified by a locally recognised governing authority.

heading: Time position
text: A temporal position described using either a (nominal) value from an ordinal reference system, or a (numeric) value in a temporal coordinate system.

heading: Temporal unit
text: A standard duration, which provides a scale factor for a time extent, or the granularity or precision for a time position.

heading: Day of week
text: The day of week

heading: Duration description
text: Description of temporal extent structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system. The temporal reference system is fixed to Gregorian Calendar, and the range of each of the numeric properties is restricted to xsd:decimal

heading: Temporal duration
text: Time extent; duration of a time interval separate from its particular start position

heading: after
text: Gives directionality to time. If a temporal entity T1 is after another temporal entity T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the end of T2.

heading: before
text: Gives directionality to time. If a temporal entity T1 is before another temporal entity T2, then the end of T1 is before the beginning of T2. Thus, "before" can be considered to be basic to instants and derived for intervals.

heading: day of week
text: The day of week, whose value is a member of the class time:DayOfWeek

heading: has beginning
text: Beginning of a temporal entity.

heading: has Date-Time description
text: Value of DateTimeInterval expressed as a structured value. The beginning and end of the interval coincide with the limits of the shortest element in the description.

heading: has duration
text: Duration of a temporal entity, event or activity, or thing, expressed as a scaled value

heading: has duration description
text: Duration of a temporal entity, expressed using a structured description

heading: has end
text: End of a temporal entity.

heading: Temporal reference system used
text: The temporal reference system used by a temporal position or extent description.

heading: has temporal duration
text: Duration of a temporal entity.

heading: has time
text: Supports the association of a temporal entity (instant or interval) to any thing

heading: in date-time description
text: Position of an instant, expressed using a structured description

heading: Temporal position
text: Position of a time instant

heading: Time position
text: Position of a time instant expressed as a TimePosition

heading: has time instant inside
text: An instant that falls inside the interval. It is not intended to include beginnings and ends of intervals.

heading: interval after
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalAfter another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the end of T2.

heading: interval before
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalBefore another proper interval T2, then the end of T1 is before the beginning of T2.

heading: interval contains
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalContains another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is before the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is after the end of T2.

heading: interval disjoint
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalDisjoint another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the end of T2, or the end of T1 is before the beginning of T2, i.e. the intervals do not overlap in any way, but their ordering relationship is not known.

heading: interval during
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalDuring another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2.

heading: interval equals
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalEquals another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

heading: interval finished by
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalFinishedBy another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is before the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

heading: interval finishes
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalFinishes another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

heading: interval in
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalIn another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2 or is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2, or is coincident with the end of T2, except that end of T1 may not be coincident with the end of T2 if the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2.

heading: interval meets
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalMeets another proper interval T2, then the end of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2.

heading: interval met by
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalMetBy another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

heading: interval overlapped by
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalOverlappedBy another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2, the beginning of T1 is before the end of T2, and the end of T1 is after the end of T2.

heading: interval overlaps
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalOverlaps another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is before the beginning of T2, the end of T1 is after the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2.

heading: interval started by
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalStarted another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is after the end of T2.

heading: interval starts
text: If a proper interval T1 is intervalStarts another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2.

heading: month of year
text: The month of the year, whose value is a member of the class time:MonthOfYear

heading: in time zone
text: The time zone for clock elements in the temporal position

heading: temporal unit type
text: The temporal unit which provides the precision of a date-time value or scale of a temporal extent

heading: day
text:
Day position in a calendar-clock system.

The range of this property is not specified, so can be replaced by any specific representation of a calendar day from any calendar.

heading: day of year
text: The number of the day within the year

heading: days duration
text: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in days

heading: has XSD duration
text: Extent of a temporal entity, expressed using xsd:duration

heading: hour
text: Hour position in a calendar-clock system.

heading: hours duration
text: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in hours

heading: in XSD date
text: Position of an instant, expressed using xsd:date

heading: in XSD Date-Time
text: Position of an instant, expressed using xsd:dateTime

heading: in XSD Date-Time-Stamp
text: Position of an instant, expressed using xsd:dateTimeStamp

heading: in XSD g-Year
text: Position of an instant, expressed using xsd:gYear

heading: in XSD g-YearMonth
text: Position of an instant, expressed using xsd:gYearMonth

heading: minute
text: Minute position in a calendar-clock system.

heading: minutes
text: length, or element of, a temporal extent expressed in minutes

heading: month
text:
Month position in a calendar-clock system.

The range of this property is not specified, so can be replaced by any specific representation of a calendar month from any calendar.

heading: months duration
text: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in months

heading: Name of temporal position
text: The (nominal) value indicating temporal position in an ordinal reference system

heading: Numeric value of temporal duration
text: Value of a temporal extent expressed as a decimal number scaled by a temporal unit

heading: Numeric value of temporal position
text: The (numeric) value indicating position within a temporal coordinate system

heading: second
text: Second position in a calendar-clock system.

heading: seconds duration
text: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in seconds

heading: week
text: Week number within the year.

heading: weeks duration
text: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in weeks

heading: has XSD date-time
text: Value of DateTimeInterval expressed as a compact value.

heading: year
text:
Year position in a calendar-clock system.

The range of this property is not specified, so can be replaced by any specific representation of a calendar year from any calendar.

heading: years duration
text: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in years
